config.name: f5_pseudo2025
config._doc: configs/f5_final.json on 2025 Jan/Feb/Jun/Jul with month-out members; the meta member's month-out predictions are its kernel's mo_G1.csv (per held month, fitted on the other three). L1a-v2 loadings refitted without the held month on the stacking lane's pass-1 rows (meta_gbm-G1short-f4p1_{mode}.parquet, col post2_recovered). Equivalent to research/final/meta/configs/meta_gbm-G1short-f4_pseudo2025.json.

prc-f-x5._note: x5 pinned to xgboost 2.1.4: prc-f-x5-mo/output/oof.csv holds all four folds (M1/M6 from that run, M2/M7 copied from prc-f-x5p-mo; identical values checked). The xgboost 3.4.1 runs were renamed prc-f-x5-xgb341 / prc-f-x5-mo-xgb341 and are not used.

recipe.name: f5_pseudo2025
recipe._doc: f5 = f4 with the d <= 1 h segment replaced by the G1short meta member: base = f4's d <= 1 h NNLS stack (c7 .145542, cs7 .252147, mlp7 .247639, fs8 c7 .354673) plus 0.5 x a LightGBM residual model (600 rounds) on the members' predictions and context, fitted on the 2025 Jan/Feb/Jun/Jul month-out predictions (Kaggle kernel usiadianimuwa/prc-meta-gbm-f4 v1, dataset usiadianimuwa/prc-taxi-2026-meta-f4 v1; research/final/meta/). 1-4 h segment, long rows, fill, overlay, cap, level, post layers and rules as f4; the L1a-v2 loadings are refitted on f5's own frozen 2025 pre-daily rows (research/final/meta/artifacts/daily_v2_f5_loadings.json).
notes: Level calibration: composition offset fitted on the 2025 12-month-out c6 OOF (research/cache/oof_mo12_c6.parquet), lam 0.75, cap 0.05.
Post layers from research/final/levers; see research/final/levers/RESULTS.md.
mlp7: 6 seeds (prc-f-mlp7m6: r2912 from prc-f-mlp7a, r2911/r2913 from prc-f-mlp7c, r2914-r2916 from prc-f-mlp7b).
Segment weights fitted on the 2025 month-out predictions (four months, rows without date-shift artifacts or short-delay y > 3 h); the long stack keeps f3's A/B weights.
c6s, c5s and x5: 6 seeds (prc-f-c6s + prc-f-c6sb, prc-f-c5s + prc-f-c5sb, prc-f-x5 + prc-f-x5b; research/final/merge_members.py). fs8 c7: 6 seeds (prc-f8-c7a + prc-f8-c7b).

d <= 1 h segment: meta member meta-g1short = solutions/kernels/prc-meta-gbm-f4/output/final_G1.parquet (research/final/meta/RESULTS.md, section f4 re-fit). Rehearsal f5 - f4, crossfit vs crossfit, two passes: nw -49.0 [-85.4, -12.2]; without LTFM February -17.6 [-45.3, +11.5].

L1a-v2 loadings refitted on f5's frozen pass-1 rows (submissions/final/meta/pseudo2025/meta_gbm-G1short-f4p1_frozen.parquet, col post2_recovered): python3 research/final/levers/daily.py v2 --rows <that file> --col post2_recovered --out research/final/meta/artifacts/daily_v2_f5_loadings.json.

meta-g1short upstream files (kernel output, the dataset's local files, the build and kernel code) are listed under its 'inputs' and hashed in the manifest; the d <= 1 h members c7, cs7, mlp7 and fs8 c7 enter f5 only through it.
